say:1:1060702001:1.text: Hi, Magister! Do you know where the nearest Dusk Camp is? Could you get us some help from there?
say:1:1060702001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，你知道最近的薄暮营地在哪吗？可以帮我们向那...

say:1:1060702001:1.female: Hi, Magister! Do you know where the nearest Dusk Camp is? Could you get us some help from there?

say:3:1060702002:1.text: We're here to clear out the rampant glimmerblooms. Little did we expect them to become even more ferocious than before.
say:3:1060702002:1.source_cn: 这片区域出现了很多失控的荧荧花，我们是过来清除它们的。...

say:4:1060702004:1.text: Our team is severely injured. We can neither leave this place nor call for help.
say:4:1060702004:1.source_cn: 我们小队三人都负伤严重，连离开这里都成问题，更没办法去求援。

say:5:1060702005:1.text: But if we get no help, these glimmerblooms might put the villagers in danger. We cannot let that happen.
say:5:1060702005:1.source_cn: 可若是不去求援，只怕这些荧荧花会危害附近的村民。我们薄...

say:6:1060702006:1.text: Get us some help from the camp, please.
say:6:1060702006:1.source_cn: 拜托你，帮我们去薄暮营地求援吧。

choice_prompt:7:1060702006.text: Get us some help from the camp, please.
choice_prompt:7:1060702006.source_cn: 拜托你，帮我们去薄暮营地求援吧。

say:9:1060702009:1.text: I'll trust you if you say so! Too bad I can't assist you...
say:9:1060702009:1.source_cn: ……既然你这么肯定，我也愿意相信你！只可惜我不能从旁协助……

say:10:1060702010:1.text: Just get back if you're having a hard time with them. We can still call for backup. Safety first!
say:10:1060702010:1.source_cn: 如果你面对荧荧花很吃力，就赶快回来，我们再去求援也来得...

say:11:1060702011:1.text: We'll wait here for your good news.

choice:7:0:1.text: No need for help, I got this.
choice:7:0:1.male: No need for help, I got this.
choice:7:0:1.female: No need for help, I got this.

say:13:1060702008:1.text: You mean you can handle them... all?
say:13:1060702008:1.source_cn: 你的意思是……你可以解决它们？！

say:14:1060702003:1.text: Yeah... We're coming to clear this whole amount of rampant glimmerblooms. But their fury is far beyond our imagination...
say:14:1060702003:1.source_cn: 是的……我们是过来清理失控的荧荧花的，可它们的狂暴远远...
